design_status: Fixed synthetic design specified before simulation; no outcome-based selection or seed search. Not independently preregistered.
selection_rule: Maximize absolute difference of the two fully specified noiseless responses over the fixed grid before drawing any new data; break equal maxima by the smaller concentration.

rng.draw_order: One standard_normal((10000, n)) array per entropy tuple, C order; mean(axis=1) then multiply by sigma.
rng.pairing: Fresh independent draws across the 18 truth/noise/replication cells. Within each cell, reuse the same standard-normal replicate array for all three design choices. Trials across designs are paired, not independent.

observation_model: Independent Gaussian errors with known common standard deviation within a cell. No rounding, clipping, truncation, rejection sampling, or reuse of original four-point observations.
decision_rule: Choose the fully specified response whose predicted mean is nearest to the new replicate mean. Exact distance ties choose q on even zero-based trial indices and f on odd indices. The tie rule does not use truth.
analytic_error: For either truth: Phi(-abs(q(x)-f(x))*sqrt(n)/(2*sigma)); at equal predictions the balanced tie rule has conditional error 0.5 over the 10000 trial indices.
aggregation: Report conditional errors under each truth separately. Their arithmetic mean is the error under an explicitly equal prior on q and f. Monte Carlo minus analytic error is a descriptive discrepancy, not a confidence interval or acceptance threshold.
limitations: Both response functions and the Gaussian noise standard deviation are assumed known; they are not estimated from four observations.
This is a fixed binary discrimination calculation, not adaptive discovery, general optimal experimental design, optimum validation, or a chemical mechanism.
Gaussian draws may leave a physically feasible yield range. No clipping is performed because it would change the declared analytical model.
The prior is used only to label the average of the two conditional error rates. No population prevalence is inferred.
A fifth noiseless point separates q from f but does not identify an arbitrary response: the constructed g still agrees with q at all five concentrations.
This standalone study reads no classroom database, calls no production worker, fits no model, and does not modify the production candidate rule.
Exact random-number replay depends on the recorded Python, NumPy, and platform environment. Source identity is not independent certification.
